reframed_request: «Сделайте нас вирусными в TikTok» → Get many cheap, varied, insight-based videos out on TikTok (cross-posted to Reels and Shorts) to raise the odds of a breakout, and turn the attention into coded WhatsApp inquiries from new people buying their first instrument (a beginner guitar, ukulele or digital piano) for themselves or a child.
business_objective: +20 coded WhatsApp inquiries from new contacts about first instruments (beginner guitars, ukuleles, digital pianos) between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15, with sales counted at the close rate measured in the chat export. The units-sold target will be set from the export at the end of week 2 (2026-11-01).
marketing_objective: People in Astana (for pickup) and elsewhere in Kazakhstan (for delivery) who are about to buy a first instrument for themselves or a child and don't know which one to choose at their budget. After watching a Muzzone video on TikTok, Reels or Shorts, they message WhatsApp with the video's code to get a recommendation, by 2026-11-15.

success_metric.name: Coded WhatsApp chats from new contacts (first-instrument lines)
success_metric.how_measured: Per-video {CODE} counted in the weekly WhatsApp chat export plus the staff label «Видео». A contact counts as new if its number has no earlier chat history. Sales are counted from the staff label «Оплачен». Codeless chats get «Откуда о нас узнали?» and are reported separately as an estimate.
success_metric.target: conservative 8 / expected 20 / stretch 35 coded chats over weeks 1–4 (2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15). Baseline: 0 coded chats (the codes are new). Total weekly WhatsApp inbound is unknown, so the week-0 count (2026-10-12–18) is the baseline, and the target is re-fixed as a multiple of it at the end of week 2 (2026-11-01).

leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median (pooled retail median until the new TikTok account has 10 posts; then the median of its own last 15 posts). Breakout = ≥3×, «вирусный» = ≥10×, reported weekly as a count
shares + saves per 1,000 views vs account median
constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸; no paid boost unless the owner approves one once a post qualifies (default)
OWNER: no direct contact yet (only via Andrey/Pavel); ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week in one batched message (default + evidence: profile.owner_access)
STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week (20 incl. safety); one mid/low-quality phone; audio only when held close to the instrument (stated: profile.staff_capacity)

FILMING: hands, instruments, instrument sound and voice only; no faces until consent is asked; customers only with consent recorded on camera; children only with a parent's written OK (default; evidence: consent not yet asked)

PRICES: only ledger prices ≤7 days old, re-fetched before publishing (e.g. as100_price, u246_price, usc40_price, uf330_price, hib_price, mapex_price, PX-770 521 935 ₸ and AP-270 734 886 ₸ as of 2026-10-09). The older piano price facts px770_price/ap270_price/diff_pno are marked do_not_use and are never used (default + evidence)

OFFER: no new offers. Existing site sale prices (e.g. hib_old→hib_price, mapex_old→mapex_price) may be shown exactly as published and re-checked. The words «финальная» and «последний шанс», and any end date, are never used until the owner confirms the reason and date (default + evidence: sale_page)

CAPACITY: retail, so stock-limited rather than labour-limited. «В наличии» and quantities only from a re-fetch ≤48 h before publishing. Many sale items have stock_qty 1–2, so no scarcity claims («осталось N») and no fast-delivery claims (default + evidence: stock_sample.json)
REGULATED: none core. Instruments for children: no claims about child development or learning outcomes (default)

AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers or beginners, naming competitors. The site's «100% оригинальный товар» is not repeated in video copy (an absolute claim with no third-party source). The site's delivery compensation in exchange for a review or video (returns_cost) is not promoted, because incentivised reviews may break platform rules (default + evidence)
TRUTH NOTES: the return policy is quoted with its conditions (returns_conditions, returns_cost). Casio service is in Almaty only (warranty_casio) and is never glossed over (evidence)

ACCOUNTS: YouTube exists (3 620 subs, 379 videos, last upload 2026-05-10), plus Instagram muzzone_astana (not analysed), VK and Facebook. TikTok: none linked, ownership unknown, so this is an owner ask. Business accounts use commercial-library music or original instrument sound only (evidence + default)
LANGUAGE: audience copy in Russian; Kazakh captions only after a native speaker checks them (default)
APPROVAL: the owner approves each weekly batch explicitly. Faces, offers and spend always need explicit approval (default)

GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min during working hours (Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–17:00 per the hours fact). A median over 60 min is flagged as the top leak before more content is made (default)
GUARDRAIL: zero published claims about stock or price that turn out stale. Any disputed fact in comments pauses that series the same day (default)
assumptions: BOTTLENECK: awareness, with consideration secondary. Confidence: low–medium. Evidence: the YouTube channel has been dormant since 2026-05-10; no TikTok is linked; Instagram is unanalysed; the best YouTube video (64 000 views) was a beginner electric-guitar demo, and L002 found beginner framing at ~7× median on long-form, which suggests choice confusion among beginners. No chat export yet, so a conversion leak (reply time, chats dying after the price) cannot be ruled out. Verify: export analysis in step 2 by 2026-10-16.

REALISM: metric = coded chats, so no close rate needed. For the expected 20 chats: req_views = 20 ÷ ([ASSUMPTION] 0.3–3 chats per 1k) = 6 700–66 700 views. ach_views (TikTok only) = 20 posts (5/week × 4) × [ASSUMPTION] cold-start median 300–1 000 × 1.8 = 10 800–36 000. ratio = 0.19–6.2, central case (1 chat/1k, median 650) ≈ 0.85. Verdict: feasible-to-stretch with a 10× uncertainty range; Reels and Shorts cross-posts add reach but are read against their own baselines. Recompute with own rates at the end of week 2; the boost question is deferred to week 2 (F10). Pooled reference: the median of 6 retail peer music channels on YouTube is ≈2 200 views (range 762–23 500, peer_channels_meta.json), which is an upper bound for a new TikTok account.

LADDER (judgment): «вирусные» → strangers see the videos → the right strangers message WhatsApp → they buy an instrument. Fork chosen: first-instrument buyers (beginner guitar, ukulele, digital piano). Reasons: measurable by codes; the best own-content evidence (64k beginner demo, L002); a deep in-stock range with fresh prices (as100, u246, usc40, uf330, PX-770 3 pcs, AP-270 5 pcs as of 2026-10-09). Margin by line is unknown. Branches not chosen: (b) clearing the «Распродажа» stock, see SECONDARY; (c) pro audio, drums and cymbals for working musicians, deprioritised because brand-only cymbal/drum demos ran at a 390-view median vs 2 300 (L006). They can still appear as wildcards tied to a buyer question.

SECONDARY: sales_push for the «Финальная распродажа» section (e.g. Hibilly Retro 30R 70 720 → 56 576 ₸, Mapex Comet 354 120 → 283 296 ₸). It gets ≤20% of slots and uses no urgency until the owner gives the reason and an end date. If Q1 = closure, this becomes the primary objective and the awareness brief is rewritten.

JUDGMENT (not covered by METHOD): the site calls its sale «Финальная», which could mean a store closure. That would invalidate an awareness objective, so it is asked as Q1 despite the 3-question cap. L004 search-intent titles (plain model names) are kept as an optional YouTube Shorts line, not as a TikTok hook formula (L003).
clarifying_questions: Почему распродажа на сайте называется «Финальная»? 1 — магазин закрывается или переезжает, 2 — уходим от части брендов/товаров (каких?), 3 — это просто название, магазин работает дальше. По умолчанию: 3, а в роликах не используем слово «финальная» и не называем сроков. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Какие товары важнее всего продавать через ролики до 15 ноября? 1 — гитары и укулеле для начинающих, 2 — цифровые пианино, 3 — ударные и тарелки, 4 — товары из «Распродажи», 5 — неважно, главное — новые обращения в WhatsApp. Можно выбрать два. По умолчанию: 1 и 2 (первый инструмент). Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Кого можно снимать: 1 — только руки, инструменты и голос, 2 — продавцов с лицом (с их согласия), 3 — и покупателей (с их согласия, дети — только с письменного разрешения родителя)? По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
push_back: Гарантировать, что ролик «залетит» в TikTok, не может никто: даже лучшие модели угадывают успех коротких видео почти наугад, мы это проверяли. Поэтому каждую неделю мы будем делать 5 разных роликов на реальных вопросах покупателей и живом звуке ваших инструментов, выкладывать их в TikTok, Reels и Shorts и усиливать то, что люди сами пересылают и сохраняют. Успех считаем не в просмотрах, а в обращениях в WhatsApp по коду из ролика. Новый TikTok-аккаунт первые 2–3 недели набирает охват неровно, поэтому точную цель зафиксируем по реальным цифрам в конце второй недели. Ещё одно: если «Финальная распродажа» означает, что магазин закрывается или уходит от части товаров, ролики нужно строить совсем по-другому, поэтому, пожалуйста, ответьте на первый вопрос.
